name: Cabecera del Llano
tagline: The modern district with the restaurants and the coworking
description: The city's most desirable area, north and east of the centre, with apartment towers, the Cabecera shopping centre, the best restaurants and the bars that make up the Zona Rosa. It is where the professional population and almost every visitor stays.
bestFor: Anyone wanting restaurants, safety and a modern flat
pros: The best restaurants and bars in the city
Safer than the centre at night
cons: The most expensive rents in Bucaramanga

name: Centro
tagline: The commercial core and the parks
description: The historic centre around the Parque Santander and the Parque Garcia Rovira, busy with commerce, markets and the university buildings. It is the cheapest central area and the most Colombian, and it empties and changes character after dark.
bestFor: Budget stays with Spanish and daytime routines
pros: The city's main parks and civic buildings
cons: Noisy and congested through the day

name: Floridablanca and Canaveral
tagline: The southern municipality with the malls and the newer housing
description: A separate municipality that has grown into the metro area, holding the Canaveral district's newer apartment complexes, the largest shopping centres and much of the region's private healthcare. It is quieter and greener than the city proper.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting newer housing and space
pros: Quieter and greener than the city
cons: Twenty minutes from the centre in traffic

name: Giron
tagline: The preserved colonial town on the edge of the city
description: A colonial town fifteen minutes southwest, declared a national monument, with whitewashed walls, cobbled streets and a river running through it. It has become part of the metro area without losing its centre, and rents there are well below the city.
bestFor: Anyone who wants character rather than convenience
pros: Genuine colonial architecture and cobbled streets
cons: Fifteen to twenty minutes from the city

name: Ruitoque and the Mesa
tagline: The plateau above the city where the paragliders launch
description: The mesa southeast of Bucaramanga, a plateau of country houses, a golf course and the launch sites that make this one of the best paragliding areas in South America. It is cooler than the city and looks straight down over it.
bestFor: Paragliders and anyone wanting a house with a view
pros: Paragliding launch sites at the door
Cooler air and views over the city
cons: The most expensive housing in the region
